title: Confirm seccomp, capabilities and per-run uids on a real Fargate task

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified on a real Fargate ARM64 task through the deployed proxy: a C program's socket() returned -1 with errno 1 (EPERM), and the program ran as an unprivileged per-run uid under a root server (capabilities CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, SETUID, SETGID, KILL sufficed). Specs still run on Docker only; this was a smoke test.

right_now_summary: A Fargate ARM64 smoke test confirmed seccomp and per-run UID behavior; full specs still run only on Docker.
